display_long_description:
# Faces are invading the sky. Pop them all.  

Goofy flying faces march in formation, spit at you and dive at your head.
You stand on a floating platform with a toy blaster. Keep them off your face.

[media]

# Loot it. Plug it in.

Popped faces drop gun parts onto the shelf at your waist.
Grab one and plug it into your gun with your own hand.

[media]

# Build your gun

Four ports, 12 parts, five rarities: every part changes how your gun fires.
After the first boss, a second gun joins in.

[media]

# Fire, ice and lightning

Set faces burning, freeze them solid, let lightning jump from face to face.

[media]

# Giant bosses

A horned brute, a King and a stone head with eye lasers.
Dodge with your body and aim for the eyes.

[media]

# Features

- **100 levels** in four worlds, a Golden Rush bonus level and a boss in every ten
- Helmets, spitters, kamikazes, splitters, healers and **golden jackpot faces**
- Combos up to **x25** and falling bonuses you shoot to take (some are bad)
- **Infinite mode**, leaderboards with your friends and the world, 17 achievements
- Stand in place: snap turn, a side step, seated play
- 13 languages
